evaluation.truth_role: Generate proposals, replay masks, lift to 3D, associate, rank, and truncate to three candidates before reading target boxes or IoU.

proposal.selection: Union unchanged full-frame proposals with fixed 40-percent corner-tile proposals; no NMS, target text, target identity, target box, or truth access.

tiling.merge: Retain up to 16 full-frame and 8 per tile, remap to full-image coordinates, then track without NMS or truth filtering.

masker.contract: Apply unchanged native SAM2 once to every retained proposal.

geometry.pair_score: Geometric mean of depth-consistent proposal-mask coverage in both directions.
geometry.candidate_score: Across incident consecutive-frame edges, rank depth-supported candidates first, then any mutual-best edge, maximum symmetric track score, objectness, and frozen proposal index.

literature_motivation.name: MV3DIS
literature_motivation.use: Depth-consistent 3D coverage supplies multi-view mask association rather than per-frame appearance confidence.

literature_motivation.name: SAMPro3D
literature_motivation.use: Posed RGB-D lifting gives view-consistent SAM evidence without task-specific training.

gate.requirements: All three fresh frames must contain a proposal with IoU at least 0.8, and at least one of the first three geometry-ranked proposals must reach IoU 0.8 in every frame.

next_action: Integrate one geometry-track region hypothesis with two target-identity hypotheses under the fixed three-candidate budget, then evaluate exact target selection on another source-disjoint family.
fallback_action: Seal this fresh negative without tuning on queue row 3; classify the failure as proposal opportunity, depth support, association ambiguity, or identity selection before changing the information source.
claim_boundary: This fresh target-family confirmation evaluates only geometry-ranked Top-3 coverage of an annotated target region. It does not identify target ownership or establish portal access, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, reliability, or safety.
